SR_MOON_NATAL_1: Health Danger & Body: The Moon returning to the Ascendant signifies that the year will focus on the native's health and physical vitality. Dorotheus warns of 'health danger' or significant changes to the physical form. It brings the native's identity to the forefront. If afflicted, beware of illness.
SR_MOON_NATAL_2: Livelihood & Expenditure: Focus on portable assets and income. If the Moon is afflicted here, it indicates loss of money or theft. If well-placed, it suggests gain through fluidity or changes in income sources. The native spends on 'Moon' things (family/food).
SR_MOON_NATAL_3: Communication & Kin: Frequent short trips, errands, and calls. 'Emotional influences compete with rational thoughts.' Focus on siblings and local environment; rumors or news play a major role. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_4: Domesticity & Privacy: Introspective and introverted year. Focus on domestic changes, pregnancy, and family roots. Restriction of social life to the 'inner circle'; excellent for settling down or real estate. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_5: Pleasure & Risk: Seek the limelight and heightened self-esteem. Reanimates sensuality; focus on romance, children, and speculation. Strong indicator of conception if in fertile signs. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_6: Illness & Duty: Heavily invested in self-organization but prone to annoyance with incompetence. Discomforts connected with subordinates; potential health concerns (cold/wet ailments). (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_7: Partnership & Visibility: Critical year for marriage or divorce. Very concerned about others' opinions; change in social position via partner. Focus on contracts and open confrontations. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_8: Crisis & Shared Resources: Emotional intensity regarding shared funds, inheritance, or taxes. Psychological transformation and dealing with 'crisis' or discrimination. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_9: Foreign & Spirit: Heart is with expansion, travel, or higher learning. Voyages, religious disputes, and prophetic dreams. A year of moving away from the familiar. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_10: Career & Visibility: Heart is with career goals; pressure to perform. Public popularity fluctuations and rise in rank or public events (good/bad by aspect). (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_11: Hopes & Friends: New ideas and progressive plans; planting seeds for future projects. Change in marital status (derived 5th from 7th) and help from social circles. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
SR_MOON_NATAL_12: Hidden & Sorrow: Need for solitude and spiritual withdrawal. Friendship with females possible but complex; enmities difficult to assuage and unfavorable for business. (Abu Ma'shar/Volguine)
